prompt: Có website cũ, source repo, brand assets và yêu cầu nghiên cứu competitor rồi redesign toàn site. Hãy bắt đầu sửa code để giao diện đẹp và khác bản cũ.
expected_outcomes: Không lao thẳng vào CSS/code dù user yêu cầu execution
Audit project truth và preserve list trước
Map owner goal ↔ user intent ↔ journey
Resolve brand evidence/status and semantic color roles
Benchmark references by page role rather than homepage aesthetics
Create Design Contract with page-role composition matrix and visible redesign delta
For 5+ different primary page roles define at least 3 top-of-page composition families unless rationale says otherwise
Implement 2–3 representative page types first and visually verify before full-site rollout
must_not: Treat ui-improvement as the main orchestrator for a whole-site redesign
Patch the old interface before design direction is concrete
Use modern/clean/premium as sufficient visual direction
Copy one hero shell to every page
Claim redesigned based on build/source checks only
